description: This file contains a test script for Git, specifically testing the handling of binary files and text conversion during merging and diff operations. It sets up various merge conflict scenarios involving binary and text files, applies attributes like 'text', 'binary', and 'textconv', and verifies Git's diff output accordingly.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the provided command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs the command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected output with actual file content.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message and attributes.
